description_md: Trailing code of `study_name` translated to NODC through `metadata/ship_renames.csv`; input to `derive_cruise_key_on_casts()`.
Cruise natural key (YYYY-MM-NODC); FK to `cruise`. Derived via `calcofi4db::derive_cruise_key_on_casts()` from `ship_code` and `datetime_start_utc`.
CalCOFI station key 'LLL.L SSS.S', derived with `normalize_site_key()` from the source's Line/Station columns.
CalCOFI grid cell; FK to `grid`. Derived via `assign_grid_key()`.
Integer pivot FK between `hplc_sample` and `hplc_measurement`; the published key is `sample_key_id`.
Natural sample key `study_name`-`cast_number`-`bottle_number`; the id part of `sample.sample_key`.
The cruise's designated month (YYYYMM) from `cruise_designation.csv`; passed to `derive_cruise_key_on_casts()` as the source designation.
